{{short description|German mathematician}}
[[File:Alfred Loewy.jpg|thumb|right|Alfred Loewy]]
'''Alfred Loewy''' (20 June 1873 – 25 January 1935) was a German [[mathematician]] who worked on [[representation theory]]. [[Loewy ring]]s, [[Loewy length]], [[Loewy decomposition]] and [[Loewy series]] are named after him.

His graduate students included [[Wolfgang Krull]] and [[Friedrich Karl Schmidt]].
